content.short: Reaper Farm is an autocompounding yield farm on the Fantom network.
content.description: Reaper Farm is an autocompounding yield farm that uses compound interest to maximize user yields. Users stake liquidity tokens in vaults, and Reaper Farm compounds them at the best available rate, faster for higher APR farms and slower for lower APY farms. Each harvest consists of 17 transactions, and the collected fees are used to cover gas costs for users. As a decentralized autonomous organization, all fees are directed toward developing the project's financial infrastructure.
